system.description:
Paranoid ruler of an iron city where every wall hides a listener.

  • Dark Gift (1st): Always know when you are being observed or followed, magical or mundane. Advantage on saves vs divination. For 1 Patron Favour, when you detect you are being watched or followed, gain Advantage on your next initiative roll or saving throw.
  • Patron's Mark (4th): For 1 Patron Favour, listen through any door, wall or floor up to 1ft thick, or any thickness of iron or steel, as if your ear were pressed against the other side, for up to 10 minutes.
  • Patron Feature (8th): For 1 Patron Favour, learn the allegiances, fears and one secret of a creature within 60ft without it knowing; a creature of Level higher than half your level makes a Will save against your Class Save DC to resist.

Allegiance: Lawful Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Dispater in the World of Arneyan wiki.
